Pressing on the neurovascular bundle in the armpit is a contraindication, so never sacrifice the clearance just to reach a height.

map.为什么手杖高度约占身高的 46%？: Why Is Cane Height About 46% of Body Height?

Too high makes you raise your shoulders and too low makes you bend over, and either adds strain to the neck, shoulders and lower back.
